name: Three-Minute Energiser
description: A lively but low-impact routine of about three minutes. No jumping and nothing on the floor.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A quick, low-impact routine of about three minutes, shown on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do a move, a few, or all of them.
howToPlay: Stand up if you can, or stay seated, and read the move.
Press Start timer for each timed move.
Press Next for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. Keep it comfortable rather than hard, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable. There is no jumping in this routine.
